subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: findSingletonEntry does not destructure or forward the live_preview parameter to createContentTypeQuery, even though IContentstackGetSingletonEntry (via ICommonContentstackConfig) accepts it. This silently drops preview context (preview_hash) for all callers of findSingletonEntry, meaning linked/tabular references fetched through this path will not show draft values — a core requirement of the story. The same defect exists in getSingletonEntry (line ~260), which also destructures only { contentTypeUid, lang, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, except, where } and omits live_preview from the createContentTypeQuery call. getEntry and getSingleEntry correctly forward live_preview, making the omission inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Add live_preview to the destructured parameters of both findSingletonEntry and getSingletonEntry, and pass it through to the createContentTypeQuery call: `}).createContentTypeQuery({ contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, only, except, where, lang, limit: 1, live_preview });` Do the same for getSingletonEntry's createContentTypeQuery call.
